items.title: Three editorial posters - cosmic wind, first light, night emission
items.description: Three poster panels side by side: a pastel pink-blue gradient ('Cosmic wind drop + Outer ... layers'), a white typographic sheet ('From the first + Down under'), and a black poster with fire glow at the base ('Night emission + Energy ingestion'). An editorial poster series, not event posters.

items.title: Neums dark landing - 'Pick up where you left off.'
items.description: A dark 'neums.' site: headline 'Pick up where you left off. Your sessions and project notes reappear when you come back.' with a golden smoke artwork top-right and an 'Opt NEUMA' selector. A landing moment, not 'Build the app you wished existed.'

items.title: '03 - TYPE / Set the tone.' wallpaper phone with font chips
items.description: A black promo panel reading '03 - TYPE, Set the tone.' beside a phone showing the pink 11:20 wallpaper with editing sliders and Geometric/Serif chips. The type chapter of the same wallpaper customizer shown in VID-0330.

items.title: Payment keypad '-$696' with Bailes and coffee screens
items.description: A three-panel strip: a dark amount entry ('-$696, Who's it for?', Credit/Debit toggle, Today/Tools/Credit Card tabs, keypad), the blue 'Meet Bailes, where live prediction meets social layer' onboarding phone (Continue with Google/Apple), and the coffee-pour lock screen with a Done pill. A payments-plus-promos montage.

items.title: Six scattered photo cards on white with a scroll arrow
items.description: Six rounded photo cards scattered on white - marble coffee top-view, lighthouse, green hill, restaurant tables, autumn path, beach shore - with a black down-arrow button below. A photo-scatter gallery, not a carousel.

items.title: Testimonial starburst - 'Designed to be read, then re-read'
items.description: An editorial promo: a white quote card ('The single most useful addition to my daily workflow.') ringed by red hand-drawn starburst strokes, then 'Designed to be read, then re-read. Add articles as you browse... PDF.' A reading-app testimonial spread.

items.title: Chibi avatar creator - swatches, sliders, expression presets
items.description: A character customizer: a chibi blonde head on a pale canvas, a right panel of skin/hair swatches and labelled sliders (CJK text), and a bottom row of expression presets with palette chips. An avatar builder, not a brush drawing tool.

items.title: N2 33 studio phones - material tokens and Let's Talk
items.description: Two phone mockups labelled 'N2 33.': the left scatters circular material tokens (coffee bean, metal, leaf, wood) around 'We design change-making website experiences' with a Let's Talk button; the right stacks circular images into a column ending in a tree. A studio's mobile promo pair.

items.title: Purple petal rosette - generative arc geometry
items.description: A light canvas where purple arcs interlock into a flower rosette around a plain central circle, a cursor at the rim. A generative line-geometry sketch, not concentric circles.

items.title: Morning routine form - category, frequency, day chips
items.description: A sage routine form: 'Morning routine' title field, Category 'Uncategorized', Frequency with 'Specific days' selected over Flexible, M-T-W-T-F-S-S day chips and a More options row. A habit-setup sheet.

items.title: ShaderKit SwiftUI code beside a Dark Environment noise-reveal phone
items.description: A split view: an Xcode-style 'ShaderKitApp.swift' listing (Created by Shubham on 22/05/26, import SwiftUI, NoiseThemeSwitcherView, ThemeManager, preferredColorScheme) beside a black phone reading 'Dark Environment' with white noise peeling in from the top edge. A shader theme-switch demo.
